observations.boundary: Real UDP sends succeed, while no socket readability or queued datagrams reach both agents during failed runs. Post-verdict plain UDP controls on the same sockets also fail to arrive.
observations.intermittent: Unmodified pinned C API had both passing and failing Mac runs; unchanged full production peer checks failed all four cases on recheck.
observations.falsified_address_lengths: Interleaved same-binary trials: native-length variant failed 2 of 8, baseline failed 1 of 8. Do not promote the length change to a production fix.
observations.ipv4_control: Binding IPv4 was diagnostic only. Production automatic dual-stack policy is unchanged.
observations.mux_control: MUX same-port control failed on Linux too and differs from production POLL mode; it does not identify a Mac-only defect.
observations.network_policy: Firewall enabled, block-all disabled, automatic signed software allowances enabled. No network/firewall configuration changed. No root/BPF capture permission.
observations.vpn_inventory: Proton VPN service observed disconnected; Tailscale connected. A later process-name inventory found only Tailscale among Proton/transparent-proxy/Tailscale names. Enabled extension registration is not evidence of active traffic interception.
observations.privacy: Apple TN3179 says terminal/SSH command-line tools and their children are automatically allowed local-network access. Packaged GUI permission validation remains open.
observations.bundle_metadata: Added NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription for packaged local peer use; this does not fix or prove the SSH networking failure.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
get_filename_component(HALO2_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${HALO2_ROOT}/cmake/macos/Defaults.cmake")
project(Halo2MacOSIceTests LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
find_package(nlohmann_json REQUIRED CONFIG)
include("${HALO2_ROOT}/cmake/TestStorage.cmake")
include(CTest)
include(FetchContent)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(USE_NETTLE OFF)
set(NO_TESTS ON)
FetchContent_Declare(halo2_ice
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/paullouisageneau/libjuice.git
    GIT_TAG b89c792e3612faf2f12cf35bcc56857313a06be3
    GIT_SHALLOW FALSE EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(halo2_ice)
option(HALO2_ICE_SOCKET_TRACE "Temporary send/receive/readiness metadata diagnostic" OFF)
if(HALO2_ICE_SOCKET_TRACE)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -B "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/socket_trace.py"
        "${halo2_ice_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-socket-trace.json" COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
    target_sources(juice-static PRIVATE socket_trace.c)
    target_include_directories(juice-static PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
option(HALO2_ICE_LENGTH_CONTROL "Temporary same-binary Darwin sockaddr diagnostic" OFF)
if(APPLE AND HALO2_ICE_LENGTH_CONTROL)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -B "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/length_control.py"
        "${halo2_ice_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-length-control.json" COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${halo2_ice_SOURCE_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD OUTPUT_VARIABLE revision OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
if(NOT revision STREQUAL "b89c792e3612faf2f12cf35bcc56857313a06be3")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "The ICE diagnostic source differs from the engine's pinned submodule")
endif()
set(source_hashes)
foreach(path src/agent.c src/conn_poll.c src/udp.c src/stun.c src/addr.c src/thread.h src/timestamp.c include/juice/juice.h)
    file(SHA256 "${halo2_ice_SOURCE_DIR}/${path}" hash)
    list(APPEND source_hashes "\"${path}\":\"${hash}\"")
endforeach()
list(JOIN source_hashes "," source_hashes)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-source.json" "{\"revision\":\"${revision}\",\"files\":{${source_hashes}}}\n")
add_executable(macos_ice_tests ice_tests.cpp)
if(HALO2_ICE_SOCKET_TRACE)
    target_sources(macos_ice_tests PRIVATE socket_trace.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(macos_ice_tests PRIVATE HALO2_ICE_SOCKET_TRACE=1)
endif()
target_link_libraries(macos_ice_tests PRIVATE LibJuice::LibJuiceStatic nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
if(APPLE)
  if(HALO2_ICE_LENGTH_CONTROL)
    foreach(arch IN LISTS CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        foreach(trial RANGE 1 4)
            foreach(variant bsd-lengths baseline)
                if(variant STREQUAL "bsd-lengths")
                    set(control_arg bsd-lengths)
                else()
                    set(control_arg baseline)
                endif()
                add_test(NAME macos_ice_length_order_${arch}_${trial}_${variant}
                    COMMAND /usr/bin/arch -${arch} $<TARGET_FILE:macos_ice_tests>
                    "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-order-${arch}-${trial}-${variant}.json" "${control_arg}")
            endforeach()
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
  endif()
    foreach(arch IN LISTS CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        add_test(NAME macos_ice_poll_${arch} COMMAND /usr/bin/arch -${arch} $<TARGET_FILE:macos_ice_tests>
            "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-${arch}.json")
        add_test(NAME macos_ice_ipv4_control_${arch} COMMAND /usr/bin/arch -${arch} $<TARGET_FILE:macos_ice_tests>
            "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-ipv4-${arch}.json" ipv4)
        if(HALO2_ICE_LENGTH_CONTROL)
            add_test(NAME macos_ice_bsd_lengths_${arch} COMMAND /usr/bin/arch -${arch} $<TARGET_FILE:macos_ice_tests>
                "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-bsd-lengths-${arch}.json" bsd-lengths)
        endif()
    endforeach()
else()
    add_test(NAME macos_ice_poll_linux COMMAND macos_ice_tests "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ice-linux.json")
endif()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Temporary same-binary control for Darwin sockaddr length initialization."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source, output = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
path = source / 'src/addr.c'
before = path.read_bytes()
text = before.decode()
if 'halo2_ice_length_control' in text:
    raise RuntimeError('The owned ICE source already contains this diagnostic')
for name, family, member in [('sin', 'AF_INET', 'sin_len'), ('sin6', 'AF_INET6', 'sin6_len')]:
    original = f'\t{name}->{member.replace("_len", "_family")} = {family};'
    if text.count(original) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('The pinned conversion site is not unique: ' + name)
    replacement = original + f'\n#ifdef __APPLE__\n\textern int halo2_ice_length_control;\n\tif (halo2_ice_length_control) {name}->{member} = sizeof(*{name});\n#endif'
    text = text.replace(original, replacement)
path.write_text(text)
output.write_text(json.dumps(dict(original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),
    diagnostic_sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
    policy='Test-only runtime flag; baseline retains original zero length fields',
    helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()), indent=2)+'\n')

tests/macos/ice/socket_trace.py.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Instrument only caller-owned pinned ICE files; preserve system call results."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

source, output = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
records={}
for name, calls in [('src/udp.c',['sendto','recvfrom']),('src/conn_poll.c',['poll'])]:
    path=source/name
    before=path.read_bytes()
    text=before.decode()
    for call in calls:
        text,count=re.subn(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])'+call+r'\(', 'halo2_ice_'+call+'(',text)
        if not count:raise RuntimeError('Pinned syscall site missing: '+call)
    text='#include "socket_trace.h"\n'+text
    path.write_text(text)
    records[name]=dict(original_sha256=hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),diagnostic_sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest())
output.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
